newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - Le Monde May 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - Le Monde May 13.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- An Ipsos poll for Le Monde finds the percentage of people under the age of thirty planning to vote for a centre-right candidate in the upcoming parliamentary election is receding.

-- LVMH chairman Bernard Arnault considers seeking a strategy director for the group. The newspaper believes a consolidation around the group's core activities in production and distribution of luxury goods appears necessary after Moet Hennessy was left out of a merger between Guinness and Grand Metropolitan.

-- Alcatel Alsthom chairman Serge Tchuruk and Dassault Industrie chairman Serge Dassault to call for a regrouping of the French defence electronics industry around Thomson-CSF before start of negotiations with potential European partners, at a news conference today.

-- Workers at British Airways' French subsidiaries TAT and Air Liberte occupied the companies' headquarters yesterday to call for a mediator, on the 34th day of a strike for improved status and wages.
-- Air France concludes strategic agreement with Air India on hub sharing and connecting flights.
